verdicts.reason: Adapter reads exactly 5 categories (OpenAIModerationAdapter.cs:178-182) and returns `new AppModerationResult(flagged.Count == 0, flagged)` (:203); the sole-violence override (:188) is computed over those 5 only. SDK 2.9.1 verified by `strings` on OpenAI.dll: get_Illicit, get_IllicitViolent, get_SexualMinors, get_SelfHarmIntent, get_SelfHarmInstructions, get_HarassmentThreatening, get_HateThreatening, get_ViolenceGraphic, get_Flagged all present, and OpenAI.xml's `OpenAIModerationsModelFactory.ModerationResult(System.Boolean, 13 x ModerationCategory)` pins that the result type carries a top-level flagged bool plus 13 categories. So an illicit-only / sexual-minors-only / self-harm-intent-only / threatening-only / graphic-only result is IsSafe=true, and IllicitViolent+low Violence with no keyword hits the override and is lifted. Routing is an exact element match on "self-harm" (ChatService.cs:1865, StoryQaController.cs:363), so SelfHarmIntent never reaches the grown-up line (SelfHarmSignal, N16, covers listed phrases only). No test pins the mapping: every moderation test overrides the virtual `ClassifyOnceAsync` seam (ModerationFailClosedTests:162-182) or calls `ShouldOverrideViolenceBlock` directly (ModerationArmenianOverrideTests:34). The class comment (:27 'keep the Flagged boolean for ALL categories') shows the intent was all categories; the 5-category read predates omni-moderation's 13.

verdicts.reason: Direction is settled by arithmetic, magnitude is not measurable here (no tokenizer: `python3 -I -c 'import tiktoken'` -> ModuleNotFoundError; no network tokenizer). OpenAICostEstimator.cs:64-69 claims 'Armenian text generally uses fewer characters per token but the over-estimate is intentional' - both halves cannot be true: fewer chars/token means chars/4 yields FEWER tokens than real, an under-estimate. The comment is simply wrong in direction. cost-per-hour-of-play-20260812.md:34-37 says '2,086 tokens is measured, not assumed' and then explains it is 8,343 summed chars - 8,343/4 = 2,085.75 -> 2,086: the characters were measured, the tokens derived. OpenAIDailyCostCapOptions.cs:60-62 `MeasuredUsdPerQuestion = 0.0078m` ('Measured USD cost') inherits it and Default 0.25 = 30 x 0.0078 (appsettings.json:65). GeminiChatClientAdapter.cs:326-345 reads only candidates/parts (usageMetadata discarded); OpenAIChatClientAdapter.cs:50-54 returns text only (Usage discarded). Consequence: the per-day QUESTION count stays ~30 as intended because the cap is derived from the same estimator, but real dollars per capped day are some multiple of the nominal $0.25; production chat is Gemini ($0.75/$3.75, appsettings:30) whose tokenizer differs again, so one constant cannot serve both.
